reviewer: independent OpenAI AI subject reviewer B
inspectionMethod: Each of the four listed files was opened with view_image at detail original. SHA-256 bytes were checked against the sealed batch before recording these observations.
scope: Image-content observations only. No publication, human approval, actual-host rendering, device, accessibility usability, learner performance or copyright clearance is asserted.

observations: Rest masses compare the mother nucleus with daughter plus alpha; energy sign and ΔE expression agree.
Kinetic energy, total-energy conservation, no additional radiation and schematic/non-scale depiction are explicitly stated.
limits: The single alpha-decay example does not demonstrate learner performance on a fresh multi-particle reaction.

observations: The supply is labelled as providing load energy; base drive is labelled as controlling the load current.
The semiconductor inset labels n emitter, thin p base, n collector consistently with the npn example.
Off/on statements use absence/suitability of base drive without supplying a misleading universal numerical threshold.
limits: This is a functional sketch, not a complete electrical circuit or model of carrier motion.
Only an npn example is depicted; the description permits either npn or pnp.
A checked circuit plan, safe supply and instruction are still required for a designated student experiment.

observations: Temperature increases to the left as explicitly labelled; qualitative positions of the main sequence, red giants and white dwarfs are plausible.
Equally spaced luminosity tick marks read 10^5, 10^2, 1 and 10^-2 solar luminosities, corresponding to unequal logarithmic intervals of three, two and two decades.
The numeric grid lacks an explicit purely schematic or nonstandard-scale qualification.
images.concern: The plotted grid suggests quantitative HRD reading although the luminosity spacing is inconsistent with a uniform logarithmic scale.
images.recommendedAction: Use a consistent labelled numerical axis if learners are to read positions quantitatively, or explicitly restrict a genuinely qualitative sketch. Do not use this image as the independently supplied correctly scaled HRD required by the evidence chain.
images.descriptionDecisionBoundary: The current bilingual description remains defensible; its KEEP is not image approval.

observations: The graphic distinguishes detection methods, habitability conditions and source/data checking.
The habitable-zone panel explicitly warns that its position does not automatically mean life.
In the direct-image inset, the label Koronagraphen-Maske points near the right edge and the small blue object rather than unambiguously to the central black occulting disk.
images.concern: The coronagraph-mask pointer is spatially ambiguous and can assign the mask label to the nearby planet instead of the stellar-light blocker.
images.recommendedAction: Place the label endpoint unambiguously on the central occulting disk; retain the distinction between potential habitability and evidence of life.
images.descriptionDecisionBoundary: This label-pointer issue cannot be repaired by changing the otherwise adequate goal description.
